ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Jipkok uses your photos for your profile, feed posts, reports, and sending photos or videos in chat.
ios.NSCameraUsageDescription: Jipkok uses the camera to take photos to share.
ios.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Jipkok uses the microphone to record videos to share.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Jipkok saves photos and videos you receive in chat to your photo library.
ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Jipkok uses your location to show nearby members sorted by distance.
ios.NSUserTrackingUsageDescription: Jipkok uses your activity to show ads that match your interests.
